categories.name: أَفْعَالُ الْبَخِيلِ وَمُعْتَقَدَاتُهُ
categories.nameEn: Actions and Beliefs of the Miser in the Quran

items.verseEn: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

items.verse: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
items.verseEn: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

categories.name: مُصْطَلَحَاتُ الْأَدِلَّةِ وَالْبَرَاهِينِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Quranic Terms for Evidence and Proof

items.verse: ۞ مَا نَنسَخْ مِنْ ءَايَةٍ أَوْ نُنسِهَا نَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍۢ مِّنْهَآ أَوْ مِثْلِهَآ ۗ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
items.verseEn: We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring forth [one] better than it or similar to it. Do you not know that Allāh is over all things competent?

items.verse: قُلْ إِنِّى عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّى وَكَذَّبْتُم بِهِۦ ۚ مَا عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ ۖ يَقُصُّ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَـٰصِلِينَ
items.verseEn: Say, "Indeed, I am on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have denied it. I do not have that for which you are impatient. The decision is only for Allāh. He relates the truth, and He is the best of deciders."

items.verse: أَمَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
items.verseEn: Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."

items.verse: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَـٰغِينَ
items.verseEn: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.

categories.name: مُصْطَلَحَاتٌ مِنْ قِصَّةِ لُوطٍ فِي سُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ
categories.nameEn: Terms from the Story of Lot in Surah Al-Qamar

items.verseEn: The people of Lot denied the warning.

items.verse: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
items.verseEn: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
So taste My punishment and warning.

categories.name: مَشَاعِرُ الخَشْيَةِ وَالخُشُوعِ لَدَى المُؤْمِنِينَ
categories.nameEn: Feelings of Awe and Humility of the Believers

items.verse: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
items.verseEn: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
And they fall upon their faces weeping, and it [i.e., the Qur’ān] increases them in humble submission.

items.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
items.verseEn: And We have already sent [messengers] to nations before you, [O Muḥammad]; then We seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves [to Us].

items.verse: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
items.verseEn: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
